statement: Between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-21 inclusive, US or Israeli forces conduct at least one new airstrike or missile strike on Iranian territory, corroborated by at least two of Reuters, AP, and AFP.
resolution: True if at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP report a US or Israeli strike on Iranian soil occurring between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-21. Strikes before 2026-11-08 do not count.
failure_condition: No strike on Iranian territory occurring in the window is corroborated by two of the named wire services by the deadline.

statement: Between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-21 inclusive, Ukrenergo or the Kyiv City Military Administration announces emergency power outages in Kyiv city attributed to a new Russian strike.
resolution: True if an official Ukrenergo or Kyiv City Military Administration statement, reported by Reuters or AP, attributes emergency outages in Kyiv to a Russian attack occurring between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-21.
failure_condition: No official Ukrainian statement attributing Kyiv emergency outages to a Russian strike within the window is reported by Reuters or AP.

statement: A new New Zealand government is sworn in by the Governor-General between 2026-11-08 and 2026-12-11 inclusive.
resolution: True if the Governor-General of New Zealand swears in a prime minister and ministry between 2026-11-08 and 2026-12-11, per the Governor-General website or Reuters.
failure_condition: No swearing-in of a New Zealand ministry occurs on or before 2026-12-11.

statement: Hakeem Jeffries is elected Speaker of the US House on the first ballot of the 120th Congress, with the vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-07 inclusive.
resolution: True if the House Clerk roll call record shows Jeffries winning a majority of votes cast for a person on the first Speaker ballot held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-07.
failure_condition: The first Speaker ballot in the window fails to elect Jeffries, or no ballot is held in the window.

statement: Front-month WTI crude settles above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one NYMEX trading day between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-04 inclusive. Reference: 90.83 on the packet date.
resolution: True if CME NYMEX publishes a front-month WTI daily settlement price strictly above 100.00 for any trading day from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-04 is at or below 100.00.

statement: The S&P 500 closes below 7,000.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-09 and 2026-12-18 inclusive. Reference: 7,376.86 on the packet date.
resolution: True if the official S&P 500 closing level published by S&P Dow Jones Indices is strictly below 7,000.00 on any trading day from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-18.
failure_condition: Every S&P 500 official close from 2026-11-09 through 2026-12-18 is at or above 7,000.00.

statement: Anthropic common shares begin trading on the NYSE or Nasdaq between 2026-11-09 and 2027-03-31 inclusive.
resolution: True if NYSE or Nasdaq exchange records show a first trading day for Anthropic shares between 2026-11-09 and 2027-03-31, confirmed by an SEC EDGAR filing.
failure_condition: No first trading day for Anthropic shares on NYSE or Nasdaq occurs on or before 2027-03-31.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one CVE affecting a QNAP product with a date-added value between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-28 inclusive.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry with vendorProject QNAP and dateAdded between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-28 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendor QNAP carries a dateAdded value in the window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least 15 entries with date-added values between 2026-11-08 and 2026-12-05 inclusive.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains 15 or more entries whose dateAdded falls between 2026-11-08 and 2026-12-05 inclusive.
failure_condition: Fewer than 15 KEV entries carry a dateAdded value within the window.

statement: Polish prosecutors announce that at least one person has been formally charged in connection with the 2026-11-07 Krakow shooting, with the charge announced between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-21 inclusive.
resolution: True if a Polish prosecutor office announcement of formal charges over the Krakow shooting, dated between 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-21, is reported by Reuters or AP.
failure_condition: No formal charge over the Krakow shooting is announced by Polish prosecutors within the window.

statement: USGS records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.5 or greater with an epicenter in Japan or within 200 km of its coast between 2026-11-08 and 2026-12-07 inclusive.
resolution: True if the USGS earthquake catalog lists an M6.5 or greater event between 2026-11-08 and 2026-12-07 whose location string names Japan or whose epicenter lies within 200 km of Japan.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows no M6.5 or greater event in the Japan region during the window.
